verdict.rationale: The quick-start docs give a single command that pulls the Docker image and starts it, promising a first AI conversation in under five minutes. The GitHub README adds pip, uv, Docker and Kubernetes install paths. Community users run it self-hosted but complain about very large Docker images, which slows setup without contradicting it. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the 'minutes to working chat' claim, and leaner images for API-only setups.
